articleTitle: A Display-driven Anti-aliasing Visualization Technology of Large-scale Vector Data in Real-time
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: Efficient and rapid visualization of large-scale vector data is a research hotpot in geographic information science (GIS). In existing popular method, the computation increases dramatically as data volumes grows, even with parallel technologies. However, the display-driven computing model (DisDC) greatly improves the ability of visualization of large-scale vector data. In this paper, we proposed a rapid visualization method based on the characteristics of DisDC, efficient data organization strategies and anti-aliasing pixel generation algorithms are designed to supporting rapid visualization and presenting better visualization effects respectively. Visualization results are organized into a tile-pyramid structure to enable stepless zooming. Experiments show that our approach can significantly reduce computation time and provide real-time visualization effects of million-scale vector data while remaining superior visualization effects.

articleTitle: Elastic Service Provisioning for Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: Major mobile edge computing service providers employ container-based virtualization so as to implement elastic service offerings. Prior works mainly dedicate to service deployment toward lower service latency and better edge resource utility. Due to the time-varying workloads at the edge, it is of critical importance to consider elastic service provisioning. In elastic service provisioning, container images need to be frequently fetched from remote cloud to edge servers, which may incur significant overhead in terms of latency and network resource consumption. Given the limited resources at the edge, we need to minimize such overhead. We exploit service migration in elastic service provisioning to reduce the overhead in terms of latency and core network resource consumption. Taking into account the dynamic of the workloads and the locations of current deployed service entities, we investigate to study the elastic service provisioning problem in this paper. We formulate the problem into an optimization problem and a greedy algorithm is designed to solve the problem. Extensive experiments validate the efficiency of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Mitigating App Collusion using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: It is well-known that many apps can drain smartphones’ compute resources at background and thus affect user experience. Recently, researchers are studying hidden compositional launch, a malicious behavior that apps wake up other apps in background without users’ awareness. Prior study has shown that covert, cooperative behaviors in background app launch are surprisingly pervasive especially on third-party appstores, and such collusion has serious impact on performance, efficiency, and security. In this work, we develop a runtime scheduler namely AppConan that can learn the user interaction behaviors over apps, monitor the hidden compositional launch online, and automatically suppresses those colluded apps affecting user-interaction experiences.

articleTitle: Learning Medical Image Segmentation via U-net Based Positive and Unlabeled Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: Assessing the location, size and number of different lesion areas is critical to medical diagnosis, surgical planning, and prognosis. Recently, the convolutional neural networks (CNN) with deep encoder-decoder architecture has shown great potential in the field of medical semantic image segmentation. Due to the supervised learning strategy used by them, these methods generally demand that the positive-labeled pixels and the negative-labeled pixels are both available in the training images. However, in many cases, the clinicians may only label part of the lesion areas as positive samples, while the negative pixels are generally too diverse to be labeled, which makes the available supervised segmentation methods inapplicable for these cases. To address this issue, we propose a U-net based positive and unlabeled learning method called U-PU, where only positive samples and unlabeled samples are used for training. It circumvents the problem of the absence of negative training samples by exploring the correlation between the underlying positive and negative pixels and thereby ensuring that the posterior class probability density functions (PDFs) are far away from each other. The experiments conducted on electron microscopy (EM) images show that U-PU can obtain good classification results and high-quality segmentation when only positive-labeled and unlabeled pixels are available.

articleTitle: The Digital Construction in Multinational Corporations: A Preliminary Study
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: The international market environment is undergoing rapid change. To advance the development of multinational corporations, the information systems in multinational corporations are expected to be constructed rapidly and optimized timely in accordance with the requirements of international business management. Moreover, the cross-border data in multinational corporations is massive, from which valuable insights can be discovered to support international business management. In this paper, we analyze the challenges of constructing information systems in multinational corporations. We propose that the new architecture with the enterprise middle platform as core should be used in multinational corporations. This architecture could accumulate common system functions, collect business data resources, and provide convenient and reusable services to the front-end information systems. Based on the enterprise middle platform, we could accelerate the construction of the information systems and conduct various data analysis. An information system is developed as an example to show that adopting this new architecture is good for multinational corporations to implement global management. The study in this paper provides meaningful references for multinational corporations to drive digital transformation.

articleTitle: Big Data Intelligence Solution for Health Analytics of COVID-19 Data with Spatial Hierarchy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: In the current era of big data, technological advancements have made it easy and quick to generate and collect huge volumes of varieties of data from wide ranges of rich data sources. These big data may be of different levels of veracity, including precise data and imprecise or uncertain data. Embedded in the data are valuable information and useful knowledge that can be discovered by big data intelligence and computing. In this paper, we propose a big data intelligence solution for health analytics with spatial hierarchy. In particular, we focus on analyzing coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) epidemiological data at different spatial granularity levels. Since its outbreak, there have been cumulatively millions of COVID-19 cases observed in various spatial locations around the world. Our solution focuses on analyzing and mining valuable information and useful knowledge (e.g., distribution, frequency, patterns) of health-related states and characteristics in populations in various spatial locations in a top-down fashion along the spatial hierarchy. To reduce redundancy, our solution discovers and returns to users (e.g., researcher, civilian) new information and knowledge not found at previous spatial hierarchical levels. The discovered information and knowledge helps the users to understand the disease better, and thus take an active role to fight, control, and/or combat the disease. Evaluation of our big data intelligence solution on real-life COVID-19 data demonstrates its practicality in health analytics of the data with spatial hierarchy and in revealing new knowledge about COVID-19 cases at different spatial granularity levels. The solution is expected to be adaptable to health analytics of other diseases.

articleTitle: CDGE —A Community Detection Algorithm Based On Graph Embedding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: Community detection is essentially a clustering problem. The introduction of k-means algorithm into community detection research has many advantages in terms of practicability and algorithm performance. However, k-means algorithm has a fatal defect – it needs to determine the community division number K in advance, which is very difficult for community discovery without prior knowledge. In this paper, a three-stage community partitioning algorithm CDGE is proposed. In the first phase, nodes in the network are embedded into low-dimensional vectors using deepWalk embedding technology. In the second stage, plot the distance distribution histogram of nodes to obtain K through the Canopy algorithm; in the third stage, input K into k-means algorithm to obtain the specific community partition results. Experimental verification in real and artificial networks shows that the clustering effect and clustering speed of this algorithm are improved.

articleTitle: Supervised learning and unsupervised learning on music data with different genres
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: As the digital music datasets evolve fast in the past decades, researchers start to focus on the machine learning tasks on music datasets with music content analysis. Both supervised learning and unsupervised learning have become increasingly popular as searching and recommending are the major tasks for digital music datasets. In this work, we are interested in exploring automatic classification of music with different genres. In this paper, we visualize and embed Spotify music in 3 dimension space with principal component analysis techniques; classifying different music genres via MFCC related algorithms and various machine learning algorithms. We use the method of PCA to determine the relationship between each feature of those songs in the data including 154932 songs and utilize different visualization techniques to obtain insight into the dataset. Thus, we could get the similarity of the songs by analyzing the two clusters of points on the graph. Additionally, we use numerous supervised learning techniques to perform classification on those songs in ten genres and evaluating their performance. Experimental results show the feasibility of automatic management of music databases and the potential to improve.

articleTitle: A Feature and Deep Learning Model Recommendation System for Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: Deep learning is becoming more and more popular in mobile applications. We also find apps using deep learning are more popular. For app designers and developers, it is particularly important to filter out certain features of corresponding scenarios and target user groups effectively from complex and diverse deep learning techniques, which is hard for developers. To solve this problem, we design a mobile deep learning application features and models recommendation system for app designers in this paper. Designers only need to input the description information of their app to acquire some appropriate features and models advice. Firstly, we analyze the feasibility and necessity of mobile application feature and model recommendation. Then the database of app details is built and sorted out to provide the basis for the recommendation system. Finally, we give out a new recommendation system specially designed for mobile apps on Google App Store, which mainly includes Labeled-LDA text classification and BERT text similarity matching combined with recommendation correction. The demonstration shows that our system has some reference value for mobile application developers.

articleTitle: Optimization of Text Generation Method for Task-based Human-machine Dialogue System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: The human-machine dialogue system is now used in all aspects of life, but the task-based system reply relies on manually marked rules and templates, which makes the text rigid and monotonous, and can not form coherent paragraphs when there is more information, but simply combine sentences together. In order to solve the above problems, this article first analyzes the construction method of the task-based dialogue system, and then proposes an optimized text generation method for the pipeline method. This paper uses the Planning-based Hierarchical Variational Model (PHVM) in the text generation phase. This model will make a global plan before generating the text, split the long text generation task into clauses, and retain the relevance between the clauses, and then generate clauses one by one. In addition, it uses sampling to introduce latent variables globally and locally to provide a variety of options for text generation. Experiments show that the model performs well in generating coherent text and rich text diversity, and solves the existing problems of task-based dialogue systems.

articleTitle: Research on Data Assets and Their Appraisal Models
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 7th International Conference on Big Data Intelligence and Computing (DataCom)
abstract: At present, the rapid development of emerging technologies such as 5G, mobile Internet and Internet of Things in China and the explosive growth of data acquisition capacity and data accumulation in various fields and enterprises are prompting China to accelerate its march from a big data country to a powerful data country. In order to give full play to the maximum value of data assets, based on the in-depth study of the connotation and characteristics of data assets, the data asset appraisal model is proposed, and the appraisal basis, appraisal elements, appraisal process, appraisal method, appraisal assurance and appraisal security are given respectively, and finally the data asset appraisal ecology is constructed.
